info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Fooddelivery Deliveries Ratings-v3-spec
info.description: The Food Delivery Ratings API enables developers to retrieve feedback and ratings associated with food delivery services. This endpoint provides essential insights into customer satisfaction and service performance by allowing access to aggregated ratings for various deliveries. Typical consumers of this API include delivery service operators and analytics platforms seeking to evaluate service quality and customer experiences. With this information, businesses can make informed decisions to enhance their offerings and address customer feedback effectively.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to obtain the current ratings for deliveries, providing insights into customer satisfaction and delivery performance. It serves as a valuable tool for assessing the quality of delivery services.
